summary: Keeps the plugin installer container build aligned with the generated SDK, runtime, and installer package versions and streams lifecycle build evidence without a fixed child-process buffer.
userImpact: Plugin installer images can be built after an internal plugin package version changes without editing version-coupled archive filenames.
Lifecycle qualification reports the complete Docker build output instead of masking an actionable packaging error behind a buffer failure.

instructions: Use @enterpriseglue/plugin-installer 0.1.2 or the matching v0.14.0 installer image when the plugin platform is released.

notes: This packaging correction changes no database schema or stored plugin data.

security: The installer image still consumes only the three package archives produced in its isolated build stage and now asserts that exactly one archive exists for each package.
rollback: Revert the installer image and @enterpriseglue/plugin-installer package together; the earlier unreleased build requires manually aligned archive versions.
validation: Run the generic plugin compose lifecycle with a clean Docker cache and require image build, local OCI publication, install, enable, disable, and cleanup to pass.
Run published-package version discipline, release-note preflight, CodeQL, and the full OSS pull-request gate.
